transcript.speaker: Dora
transcript.line: Every little step has helped you grow into who you are today. And there are so many wonderful adventures still ahead.

transcript.speaker: Dora
transcript.line: Ready, Akhila? Let’s go on an adventure!

voiceLines: Hi Akhi! Happy birthday! Keep your first envelope close, and tap for a hint whenever you need one.

stops.title: A small beginning
stops.clue: A little golden surprise is stowed away among many cherished memories of you and your significant other.
hints: Your first surprise is hiding in my room.
Something small and shiny is waiting in a case I made for you.
Look in the box that holds our memories for your handmade ring case.
stops.photoPrompt: Your new rings and the case I made for you.
stops.foundLabel: Gold rings in a handmade case
stops.sfxPrompt: Soft pillow whoosh followed by a gentle magical sparkle, cozy and short
voiceLines: Envelope one! A little golden surprise is stowed away among many cherished memories of you and your significant other.

stops.title: Follow the water
stops.clue: Royalty stands in for something usually grey. Winter is in my name, and you first discovered me last year. Figure out where to find me.
hints: This one is something to drink.
Your favorite boba place — the one with a number in its name.
T4: Wintermelon Milk Tea with royal tea instead of Earl Grey.
stops.sfxPrompt: Playful boba straw slurp with ice cubes rattling in a plastic cup
voiceLines: Envelope two! Royalty stands in for something usually grey. Winter is in my name, and you first discovered me last year. Figure out where to find me.

stops.title: Class break
stops.clue: Even an Avatar has classes. Your adventure continues afterward.
stops.resumeNote: The map is snoozing. The hunt picks back up around 2. No rush.
stops.sfxPrompt: Soft, sleepy little leopard snore, cute and quiet
voiceLines: Go be responsible, I’ll nap till 2.

stops.title: An envelope from your people
stops.clue: I’m spelled with five letters, I serve meals in a black plastic bowl, and I don’t believe in charging you extra for the green stuff. What am I?
hints: I live on Monroe.
You build your bowl down the line, one ingredient at a time.
Qdoba on Monroe.

pizza.clue: Even an Avatar needs to eat. Your friends picked a slice of something you love — follow them to {place}.
hints: Your friends know you’re hungry after class.
Round, cheesy, cut into triangles.
Pizza at {place}.

stops.sfxPrompt: Sizzling skillet on a hot grill, short and appetizing
voiceLines: Envelope three — from your people! I’m spelled with five letters, I serve meals in a black plastic bowl, and I don’t believe in charging you extra for the green stuff. What am I?

stops.title: Birthday bonus
stops.clue: I have ten tips but never speak. I get filed down, but I’m not a document. I might get a French look without ever leaving Oregon. What am I?
hints: (your predator)i _ _ _ _
mani(“_ _ _ _” to cancer)
voiceLines: I have ten tips but never speak. I get filed down, but I’m not a document. I might get a French look without ever leaving Oregon. What am I?
stops.photoPrompt: Show off your fresh new nails.

stops.title: A place with roots
stops.clue: We’ve both called this place home. Even though you left, one of your favorites still stands here, holding down its roots. Find me.
hints: Somewhere you both used to live.
The Retreat — and something tall and green you love there.
Your favorite tree at the Retreat.
stops.photoPrompt: You, your tree, and your new spotted friend.
stops.sfxPrompt: Leaves rustling in a light breeze with soft birdsong
voiceLines: Envelope four! We’ve both called this place home. Even though you left, one of your favorites still stands here, holding down its roots. Find me.

stops.title: A little air time
stops.clue: At five, find the court where love means zero and the shuttle does the flying.
hints: Bring your energy — this one’s a game.
Rackets, nets, and a shuttle. On campus.
The badminton courts at Dixon.

homeBackup.title: A little playtime
homeBackup.clue: Your next clue is waiting where today began. Come home at five—there’s more to unwrap.
hints: Head back to where the day started.
You’ve been here once already today.
Back home — your people are waiting.

stops.sfxPrompt: Badminton shuttlecock thwack followed by a small happy crowd cheer
voiceLines: Envelope five! At five, find the court where love means zero and the shuttle does the flying.

stops.title: A little spark
stops.clue: Before holding hands became our thing, our fingertips had their first little meeting. Find the spot outside the café.
hints: Think back to our first little fingertip moment.
A café on Monroe whose name sounds like something dropping from the sky.
Outside Bombs Away Cafe.
stops.photoPrompt: Your new bookmark, right where our fingertips first met.
stops.sfxPrompt: Soft cute cartoon poof with a tiny sparkle
voiceLines: Envelope six! Before holding hands became our thing, our fingertips had their first little meeting. Find the spot outside the café.
